Report a problem

Noticed a broken cable, weird buzz, settings that look wrong, or anything else? Tell us here. No login needed. The deacon will get an email and decide what to do.

Reports go to the deacon's email. They will not appear on this site unless the deacon promotes them into the public issue log.

Suggestions on this site are guidance, not professional advice. If you are unsure, stop and ask an experienced sound engineer.
